metadata.evidence_basis: Generic sample: attack-surface + identity-trust + reachability collectors merged by aws-attack-graph-builder; enumerated by the chain enumerator.

kill_chains.title: Public S3 bucket -> harvested key -> data-store exfiltration
kill_chains.objective: Bulk theft of the primary object-store data corpus
misconfigurations: Long-lived static access key embedded in public object
S3FullAccess attached to the harvested principal
No object-level access logging on example-data-lake
kill_chains.evidence: GuardDuty Exfiltration:S3/AnomalousBehavior observed on example-data-lake (sample evidence record ADT-1).

kill_chains.title: Public admin-port host -> instance role -> account pivot
kill_chains.objective: Turn one internet-exposed host into account-level administrative access
misconfigurations: EC2 host example-bastion with 22/tcp open to 0.0.0.0/0 (333333333333)
Instance profile grants broad EC2 and SSM permissions
OrganizationAccountAccessRole trusts the management account with no condition

techniques.title: Anonymous read of public S3 buckets
misconfigurations: 3 public-readable buckets across 2 accounts, incl. example-public-assets

techniques.title: Steal long-lived static access keys
techniques.chain: reuse durable keys harvested from public objects
misconfigurations: Static key embedded in a public object; key age > 400 days; never rotated

techniques.title: Harvest instance-role credentials via IMDS/SSRF
techniques.chain: SSRF or on-box read of IMDS -> instance role creds
misconfigurations: IMDSv1 enabled on example-bastion; instance profile over-scoped

techniques.title: OrganizationAccountAccessRole into member accounts
techniques.chain: assume org role from management account -> admin everywhere
misconfigurations: OrganizationAccountAccessRole trusts management account 111111111111 in all member accounts

techniques.title: Reuse harvested keys across accounts (S3FullAccess)
techniques.chain: use S3FullAccess key against buckets in other accounts
misconfigurations: S3FullAccess attached to a shared automation principal reachable from 2 accounts

root_causes.scope: trusted by management account in all member accounts

gaps.reason: Instance metadata options were not collected; IMDSv1 exposure is inferred, not measured.
Access-log bucket read was denied, so the exact exfiltrated object list is unrecoverable.
gaps.recommended_collection: Enable and read S3 server access logs / CloudTrail S3 data events on example-data-lake
